topic: Emphasis of Matter and Other Matter paragraphs
question: Distinguish between an Emphasis of Matter paragraph and an Other Matter paragraph under SA 706, giving examples of when each may be used.
sources: SA 706 Emphasis of Matter Paragraphs and Other Matter Paragraphs in the Independent Auditor's Report
SA 701 Communicating Key Audit Matters in the Independent Auditor's Report

points.label: Meaning of Emphasis of Matter
points.description: A paragraph that draws attention to a matter already properly presented or disclosed in the financial statements which, in the auditor's judgment, is so important that it is fundamental to users' understanding of them.
points.basis: SA 706, definition of Emphasis of Matter paragraph

points.label: Conditions for using Emphasis of Matter
points.description: Used only when the auditor would not modify the opinion for that matter and, where SA 701 applies, the matter has not been determined to be a key audit matter; it refers only to information in the financial statements.
points.basis: SA 706, requirements for including an Emphasis of Matter paragraph

points.label: Examples of Emphasis of Matter
points.description: For example an uncertainty about the outcome of unusual litigation or regulatory action, a significant event after the reporting date, early adoption of a new accounting standard with a pervasive effect, or a major disaster that has badly affected the entity's financial position.
points.basis: SA 706, examples of circumstances for an Emphasis of Matter paragraph (application material)

points.label: Meaning and examples of Other Matter
points.description: A paragraph on a matter not presented or disclosed in the financial statements that is relevant to users' understanding of the audit, the auditor's responsibilities or the report, for example a restriction on distribution or use of the report, reporting on more than one set of financial statements, or prior period statements audited by another auditor.
points.basis: SA 706, definition of and requirements for an Other Matter paragraph

points.label: Presentation and limits
points.description: Each goes in a separate section with a suitable heading; an Emphasis of Matter section states that the opinion is not modified for the matter. Neither replaces a modified opinion, the going concern material uncertainty section or required disclosures, and the auditor tells those charged with governance in advance.
keywords: communication with those charged with governance
points.basis: SA 706, placement in the report and communication with those charged with governance
